deviations_from_card: (1) A fourth refusal reason, 'next_is_a_decision', alongside decided/too_early/no_slot: an interview candidate's move act is shut because the next ladder stage (Offer) is a decision, and none of the card's three reasons names that; the server's existing text for it ('Offer is a decision. Use the decision controls.') became REFUSAL.not_a_move. (2) buildBoard hands down every slot with status and holder (BdBoard.slots replaces openSlots) and actsFor derives the per-candidate list (own held first, then up to 12 free), rather than a per-candidate list in buildBoard; same result, one predicate. (3) read_view's L0 payload moved into a pure boardRead(board) in tools/read.ts so node --test can assert it. (4) The move act is defined as 'forward one ladder step' (nextMoveFor); moveStage still accepts interview->screening, which is not offered as a button; documented in ADR 0107 decision 5. (5) One server message changed: scheduling a decided candidate now returns REFUSAL.decided instead of 'too early... Move X to Interview first'; ok:false is unchanged. (6) Gate's slot select marks held slots ' - held for them'; Propose slots is disabled with 'No slot is open' when nothing is free (the action already refused that). ADR is 0107.
